description: This file defines the SugarFieldEnum class, a subclass of SugarFieldBase, which manages the rendering, import sanitization, and formatting of enum type fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes methods for rendering detail, edit, and search views, as well as handling import data sanitization and value formatting based on options defined in the application.

classes.name: SugarFieldEnum
classes.description: Manages enum field rendering, filtering, and import sanitization in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the detail view for enum fields, with support for HTML returns via a callback function.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the edit view for enum fields, defaulting size parameter if not provided.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the search view for enum fields, defaulting size parameter if not provided.

methods.name: displayFromFunc
methods.description: Delegates display rendering to specific functions based on display type, supporting HTML output.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input values during import, normalizing display values to keys and handling case-insensitive matches.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats raw enum value into a display string based on options array.
